## Added scope: bind the record to its author (item D of the delegation evaluation)

A Fable evaluation of the low-risk Tier H delegation (write-up `pm-orders/review/33531-delegation-review.md`, read on PR #33531 head `e2b1cabc`) found that `locateReviewOfRecord` in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` reads the comment body only: header, `Head-sha:`, `Reviewed-by:`, `Served-tier:` and (on the arm) `VERDICT: PASS`. It never reads who posted the comment, so on a public repository any commenter can post a body the guard accepts. Since this card already reworks the same leg (the Tier S record leg reads no verdict), carry the author binding here: the guard accepts a record only from the fleet relay bot or an organisation member, and an unreadable author refuses. Pin both directions in the queue battery. Added 2026-11-15T02:20Z.
